misc: Adopted a L.A.B. Golf zero torque putter for the 2025 season
biography: Simo, representing Hirsala Golf, is set to mark his eleventh participation in the esteemed Hector Trophée in 2026. This consistent presence solidifies his standing as a seasoned competitor within this unique pair competition, bringing a wealth of experience to the championship greens.

His record in the Hector Trophée is particularly notable for its emphasis on collaborative success. Simo has been a pivotal member of the winning pair on three separate occasions, demonstrating an exceptional aptitude for the demanding team format. These victories underscore his invaluable contributions in forging successful partnerships. However, despite these collective triumphs, the individual Victor Trophy has, to date, eluded him, a testament to the distinct challenges posed by both facets of the tournament.

Simo's commitment to refining his game is evident in his recent equipment choices; for the 2025 season, he strategically adopted a L.A.B. Golf zero torque putter, signaling a continuous pursuit of marginal gains on the greens. Beyond his technical approach, Simo is also known for a vibrant and often vocal on-course presence. His expressive nature, which can occasionally manifest in a colorful vocabulary, reflects a profound passion for the sport and the intensity of competition.

As he prepares for his next appearance, Simo remains an active and formidable participant, eager to leverage his extensive experience and competitive fire. His pursuit of further accolades, both team-based and individual, promises to add another compelling chapter to his already distinguished Hector Trophée journey.
